name: Prowlarr
description: One place to manage indexers for Sonarr, Radarr and Lidarr.
compose:
services:
  prowlarr:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/prowlarr:latest
    container_name: prowlarr
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "{PORT}:9696"
    environment:
      PUID: "1000"
      PGID: "1000"
      TZ: "{TZ}"
    volumes:
      - {DATA}/config:/config
